tour-parque-nacional-de-timanfaya-montan.description:
There are lot to visit on Lanzarote. Caves, volcanoes, impresive views, garden, museums, and more.
If you want to visit all the Tourist Centres on Lanzarote, we recommend you take advantage of the VOUCHER FOR 6 CENTRES and benefit from discounts. In addition to saving up to 20% on fees, it will speed up access at some of the centres. 

The Voucher for 6 Centres includes the admission to the Timanfaya National Park, Jameos del Agua, Cueva de los Verdes, Mirador del Río, Cactus Garden and the Castle of San José. All of them constitute the main tourist reference, being a must to understand the true essence of Lanzarote. 
Timanfaya National Park, known as the Fire Mountains, will surprise you with its mysterious lunar landscape formed by large volcanic eruptions between 1730 and 1736. Timanfaya National Park opens from 9.30 am to 4 pmCueva de los Verdes and Jameos del Agua are inside the volcanic tunnels produced by the eruption of the Corona Volcano. Both caves have been conditioned to receive visitors with incredible lighting systems. In the Jameos there is even a small auditorium to hold concerts, designed by César Manrique. Cueva de los Verdes opens from 10 am to 4 pm  and Jameos del Agua from 10 am to 5 pm The Cactus Garden is located in an old quarry and contains thousands of specimens of different species of cactus from the Canary Islands and other parts of the world. Cactus Garden opens from 10 am to 5 pm Mirador del Rio is a viewpoint located at the top of 480 meters high cliffs overlooking the strait that separates Lanzarote from the neighboring island of La Graciosa. Mirador del Rio opens from 10 am to 5 pm The International Museum of Contemporary Art (MIAC), located in San José Castle, exhibits works by Miró, Millares, Mompó, Cárdena and Manrique. San José Castle opens from 11 am to 6 pmThere are lot to visit on Lanzarote. Caves, volcanoes, superb viewpoints, garden, museums, and more.
When completing your booking, you can download the RESERVATION VOUCHER that you must PRINT and DELIVER at the ticket office on the first centre you visit to get the  VOUCHER FOR 6 CENTRES. It is valid for 14 days and showing all the tourist centres to be visited. This VOUCHER FOR 6 CENTRES must be PRESENTED and SEALED at each centre you visit.  Please, take note that if you lose your VOUCHER FOR 6 CENTRES, you will not be able to claim and you will lose not only the money paid but also the right to visit the places that have not been visited.

senderismo-parque-natural-de-los-volcane.title: Trekking | Lanzarote’s Los Volcanes Natural Park
senderismo-parque-natural-de-los-volcane.summary: A unique tour to see volcanoes, craters, lava flows, seas of lava and volcanic ash. Amazing landscapes where you can see the most varied shapes and colors and contemplate the different stages of the formation of life. The excursion takes place on the edge of the Timanfaya National Park. Easy hike.
senderismo-parque-natural-de-los-volcane.description:
A unique tour to see volcanoes, craters, lava flows, seas of lava and volcanic ash. Amazing landscapes where you can see the most varied shapes and colors and contemplate the different stages of the formation of life. The excursion takes place on the edge of the Timanfaya National Park. Easy hike.
An overwhelming landscape, in which fire, ash and rock mergeTour the Los Volcanes Natural Park with the help of a local hiking expert.
Did you know that Los Volcanes Natural Park is a protected area that represents the volcanism of Lanzarote? This natural park has its surface covered by lava that comes from eruptions dated between 1730-1736; and in 1824.

You can enjoy trekking between volcanoes with just you and your group, up to 8 people. It is an exclusive hike, with the guide at your disposal, to chat in a relaxed way about the hidden treasures of Lanzarote.

The route runs inside the Los Volcanes Natural Park, to the east. The map indicates the specific areas where stops are made and explanations of points of interest given. Some of the characteristic points of the route are the volcano of La Rilla, the volcano of Señalo and the caldera of Santa Catalina.

It will be 7 kilometres and 3 hours of walking on a circular route through this natural park.

Learning volcanic science. 
The magnificent conservation of the landscape, thanks to the arid climate of Lanzarote, will leave you stunned. Get ready to travel back 25 million years to the Oligocene. On the seabed, a volcanic edifice was emerging, the island of Lanzarote, which when surfacing from of the sea emitted magma and lava began to pile up.  This trip will take you from the birth of the Canary Islands to the present day. You will learn about the internal forces of our planet and how Lanzarote and the Canary Islands were at the beginning. A whole class of volcanic science. 

Lunar landscape. 
Unique views of a volcanic landscape with strange formations due to the solidification of lava. Sharpen the view and find these singular formations: we will cross the lava flows, we will ascend to the volcanic cones, we will pass by the volcanic tubes and discover lava lake formations, craters, tunnels, hornitos and much more. 

In search of vegetation. 
Vegetation is scarce, and is only present in areas with older lava solidification. On the lava, we will find a timid resurgence of life: fungi, lichen, majorera asparagus and purpurario gongarillo. 

The surviving fauna. The Natural Park of Los Volcanes has been declared a Special Protection Area for Birds (ZEPA). A zone of special protection for birds (ZEPA) is a category of protected areas listed by the member states of the European Union as natural areas of unique relevance for the conservation of birds threatened with extinction. Despite the extreme conditions of aridity, lack of vegetation and water, 200 species inhabit this park (50% vertebrates), 24 of them protected. Reptiles and birds stand out.

Breathtaking jeep safari in the north of LanzaroteThe jeep safari in Lanzarote takes you through the contrasting landscape of the north and you discover charming villages in the middle of an indescribably beautiful volcanic landscape. The eventful excursion starts in the morning hours at your hotel and you drive with the 4x4 Land Rover Defender 110 SW with 7 seats together with the driver and the other jeeps towards Guatiza. There you visit a cactus plantation and experience very closely how the cochinilla are bred. From the scale insects that settle on the prickly pear, the red dye carmine is obtained, which is used, among other things, to colour drinks, cosmetics and fabrics. Afterwards you reach the village of Mala and pass the oldest cactus garden of the Canary Islands. Continuing north through the villages of Arrieta and Punta Mujeres, you will finally reach Jameos del Agua and Cueva de los Verdes, two of the most important objects created by the famous landscape architect César Manrique. The jeep safari through Lanzarote's north includes entry to one of the two sights. You decide which one you want to visit.

You drive along the north coast and reach the famous dream beach Caletón Blanco, which captivates by its crystal clear water and its white sand. Nearby, also in the municipality of Haría, you can visit the fishing village of Órzola. There you have the possibility to explore the small town, which is known for its excellent fish restaurants, to refresh yourself with a drink in a nice café or to eat something. The discovery jeep safari in Lanzarote continues towards the Ye and you stop at the Mirador del Rio, a famous viewpoint on the volcanic Atlantic island. From there you have a magnificent view of the offshore islands of La Graciosa, Montaña Clara and Alegranza. Another stop will be at the viewpoint Mirador de Guinate and the guide will explain the different layers of rock. At the end of the exciting jeep tour in Lanzarote you will cross the original village of Los Valles and the former island capital Teguise and finally reach the former residence of César Manriques as the last point of the adventurous exploration trip.

On wednesdays we propose to cross to Fuerteventura, an island with paradisiacal beaches and turquoise and emerald colours. A more than recommended escape from the nearby island of Lanzarote. We pick you up at the bus stop closest to your hotel to take you to Playa Blanca where you take the boat of Lineas Romero to Fuerteventura. The trip by sea takes approximately 30 minutes. In Fuerteventura you will have free time to visit the places that interest you most on the island.

Once in Fuerteventura, the town of Corralejo offers us a charming promenade, full of shops and restaurants. If you want to enjoy a relaxing day, you can sunbathe on the beautiful beaches of Flag beach, El Moro or El Burro. On these beaches, you can also enjoy a show of sails and colors by the people who practice windsurfing and kiteboarding. The ideal way to get around in Fuerteventura is by rental car, taking a taxi or the bus. You can take advantage of this to visit El Cotillo, another town also famous for its cliffs, unspoilt and wild beaches, and a hypnotic swell. If you wish you can take a bus or taxi to go to the dunes. The Natural Park of Las Dunas de Corralejo is a desert with the largest dunes in the Canary Islands and a turquoise blue sea that will make you fall in love. 
Don't get confused about the time of return so you don't miss the ferry back to Lanzarote.

We pick you up at the rearest bus-stop from your hotel and take you to the Marina of Puerto del Carmen where we board the speedboat to enjoy a 1.5 hour journey to reach the island of Lobos. 
During the trip, the crew will give you detailed information about the cetacean species that you will be able to see. Although whale watching is not guaranteed, this excursion has a high percentage of success.
On arrival you will find the visitor centre where you can pick up general information about the small island. The small island has splendid bathing areas such as La Concha Beach, with its yellow sand, totally sheltered from the waves, and el Puertito where you can enjoy the wonderful clear waters. 
A great chance to see wild and free *dolphins. Although sightings are not 100% guaranteed.
Lobos Island is a very small island measuring only about 4.58 km2. It lies off the north east of the island of Fuerteventura. The two islands are separated by La Bocayna strait, which has a maximum depth of 30 metres. The island can be seen clearly from Corralejo.
It owes its name to the fact that in the past monk seals (also known as sea lions) lived on this island. Today they are totally extinct on the island.

The small island is part of the Corralejo Dunes Natural Park. It is home to more than 130 plant species and several bird species; of particular note are the herring gull, the bustard (at certain times of the year) and the Cory’s shearwater. The sea bed is an area of underwater reserve and contains considerable ecological wealth. The highest point (123 m) is at La Caldera

In the eastern half of the island there are numerous hornitos, mounds known as “little ovens” (often circular in shape and rising to a peak), an attractive and singular feature of the landscape.
Recent archaeological findings have concluded that Ancient Rome established a (possibly seasonal) settlement in the island, related with the obtention of purple dye.

tour-excursion-fotografico-lanzarote.description:
Immortalize the landscapes of Lanzarote on a unique tour

Have you ever wanted to learn from a professional photographer how to photograph the landscapes of your dreams? Then this Lanzarote Experience Tour is what you are looking for: Photographic tour of the volcanic sites of Lanzarote. Over four hours you can discover and immortalise the hidden beauty of the most incredible corners of this island.

Photography Tours:

1. Volcanoes and La Geria,

2. Teguise and Famara,

3. Salinas de Janubio and El Golfo.
The activity is carried out in small groups to ensure that all participants can take photographs and receive personalised guidance from our professional photographer.

After four hours approach the end of the tour. We say goodbye after exchanging thoughts on our Photografic experience hunting the best photos of the island. You won’t regret joining us!

1. Volcanoes and La Geria

The Natural Park of the Volcanoes, with its lunar landscapes, will be the main stage of this Phototour absolutely uncommon.

The Volcano del Cuervo, It will give us the opportunity to enter into the caldera to photograph the many colors of its stones and shapes of rocks molded by the heat of the eruption. The cone stand out on the horizon with its particular shape that makes every shoot different from another and absolutely unforgettable.

La Montaña Negra with its shrubs disseminated on the slopes of black lava will form an excellent contrast with the blue sky, giving to every single shoot a secure appeal. The Montaña Roja lit by the sun will became, through the lens of the camera, of a bright red that fades into orange then yellow, and finally into black.

Parque Natural de La Geria, with its unique landscape characterized by cultivations of grapewines placed in holes dug in the volcanic rock and protected from the wind by stone walls, will allow us to realize pictures of a unique landscape.

Places we visit:

•	Volcán del Cuervo

•	La Geria

Perfect for: photographer's looking to take photos from inside the crater of a volcano. Not something you see every day!

2. Teguise and Famara

The 500-year history of the ancient capital of Lanzarote and the "wild" Caleta de Famara with its windswept beach will be destination of this unforgettable Phototour.

Teguise first and ancient capital of the island with over 500 years of history with the imposing church of Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe of the 16th century will put us able to capture beautiful urban views, apply the rule of thirds to the low white buildings and take advantage of the narrow streets paved in stone as guidelines.

Caleta de Famara, a small village characterized by sandy roads and houses close to each other, will allow us to take advantage of the light and the shadows for compositions with geometric patterns and "graphics". Famara beach, considered ones of the most beautiful and wild of the island, whose sand dunes and surfers from around the world will be the stage, the scenes and the protagonists of our shots at the base of the imposing Risco. The reflection of the clouds and the sky on the water surface will give our shots an irresistible charm.

Perfect for: photographer's looking to get amazing waterscapes and breathtaking vistas of the coast

This phototour to The Salinas de Janubio with its tanks of thousand of colors and the quiet and remote location of El Golfo give us photographs to show off to friends. The Salinas de Janubio shall lay motionless in front of the objectives of our cameras in a very wide variety of colors, from pure white to bright pink, from black to pale yellow. The typical pyramids of salt that dries in the sun will be an excellent reason for a textbook photographic composition.

The remote fishing village of El Golfo and the near (short walk) Charco de los Clicos enable us to make landscape photo shoots exploiting composition rules more classic and experimenting with new ones.

bautismo-buceo-museo-atlantico-lanzarote.description:
Do you often have the desire to experience something new in unique places? Learn to scuba dive in a museum! Sounds quite weird isn’t it? But yes, that’s true. For your first time underwater, you will be swimming among shoals of endemic fishes such as “bocinero”, “cherne” or maybe the infamous butterfly stingray; not forgetting the various sculptures and the message behind them: the drama of immigration, the misuse of natural resources but always with a beacon of hope. 

The try dive courses don’t require any previous experience and a qualified instructor will assist you from start to finish: without any doubts, you’ll enjoy your dive to the fullest!
The underwater Museum Lanzarote “Museo Atlántico” has been conceived as a place to promote education and preserve and protect the marine and natural environment as an integral part of the system of human values. Jason deCaires Tayor sends us a latent message in his work: the defence of the oceans. This museum project is creating a huge artificial reef made up of a series of pH neutral cement sculptures which, over time, will help the marine biomass flourish and facilitate the reproduction of species on the island. The museum is 12-15 metres deep down pristine waters near the south coast of Lanzarote, in the Bahía de Las Coloradas, a place that was chosen mainly due to the physical characteristics of its sea bottom. It covers a 2,500-square-metre surface that divers and scuba divers have access to.
 Divers can enjoy the magnificent Atlantic Museum, dive amongst the statues created by artist Jason DeCaires Taylor & visit a nearby reef, Las Coloradas.
The Atlantic Museum is a one-of-a-kind museum in the Canary Islands – and to a greater extent, in the world! Various pH neutral works of art especially designed to boost aquatic life have been dropped off on the bottom of the sea. Since 2016, when the underwater museum was first created in Lanzarote, presence of fishes in the area has risen and the sculptures have become unconventional reefs. Sounds cool right? Well, live it by your own!

The Experience step by step

1.	First dive: We will give you a theoretical lesson where the diving basics will be settled down such as security, what to do and not to do, so your first dive can be as smooth as posible. Right after the lesson we are going to put it in practice in Playa Flamingo.

2.	Second dive: We will go back to the cristal clear water of Playa Flamingo, where your instructor will carry you 12 metres underwater to practice a few more security exercises and other advanced diving techniques.

3.	Break: After the two first dives, we are going to have a break in our diving centre, where you’ll be able to enjoy a snack on our terrace and rest a moment before going back like new for your final dive!

4.	Discover Scuba Diving: We are ready to Discover Scuba Diving! We will head to Museo Atlántico, a mind blowing museum in Lanzarote. A wonderful submerged world made of various works of art, home of fishes, reefs and other sea animals. You won’t regret having chosen this spot for your first scuba diving experience!

espeleologia-familia-lanzarote-cueva-de-.description:
We suggest you discover and enjoy visiting the interior of a volcanic cave. A baptism in caving will allow you to have a first contact in the world of caving with your family and friends.
Also known as Cueva de Las Palomas de Masdache, this is a volcanic tube that was formed in the pahoehoe lava flows of the last phases of the Timanfaya eruption from 1730 to 1736. Its formation is associated with changes in the volume of lava emitted during the active period. The tube has been mapped by cavers. Its orientation is approximately NW-SE direction and it extends to over 1640 m in length approximately. With respect to its layout, the tube is divided into two branches. This tube is characterised by a high degree of conservation and displays the full range of morphology characteristic of this type of volcanic caves, such as cornices, lava platforms, central columns, stalactites to the roof and base of the cave (the best preserved in the Canary Islands), formed by dripping lava. The tube consists of several galleries in which it is possible to see partial collapses of the roof and jameos.

This geosite is of major volcanological and secondary geomorphological type interest. Additional historical interest, and for speleology. This is part of the Geosite “VC007 Parque Nacional de Timanfaya” which is of international importance.
recommendations: The visit of the volcanix tube does not take more than 30 minutes

piratas-experience-siguiendo-las-huellas.description:

We will start our pirate route visiting the refuge most used by the aborigines in pre-Hispanic times, La Cueva de los Verdes.

After we will then go to the Castle of Guanapay or Santa Barbara, built in the fifteenth century to

The castle is today a  museum of piracy and in it you will learn very interesting facts about the pirates that besieged this island such as Morato Arraez or John Hawkin.
We then head north to embark on the ferry towards La Graciosa, a paradise of turquoise blue waters and golden sand

This is the island where the pirates performed repairs on their ships and where according to legends there are still treasures buried by the pirates that were never found. The César Manrique Foundation is located in the spectacular home designed by César Manrique himself upon his return from New York. Inhabited by the artist for 20 years, from 1968 to 1988, it is the house in which he lived the longest. It was located in the middle of a lava flow that originated the great eruptions that occurred on the island between 1730 and 1736. In this construction, which occupies 3,000 square metres on a 30,000-square-metre estate, the dialogue between the building and nature stands out. The upper floor is inspired by the traditional architecture of Lanzarote to which it incorporates functional elements of modern conception. The lower level takes advantage of five natural volcanic bubbles connected by tunnels excavated in the lava. The gardens surrounding the house combine the fascinating contrasts of vegetation, works of art and volcanic ash with fruit trees and other plants.

The Hause Museum in Haría, in the north of Lanzarote, was designed by the artist to work and enjoy the final years of his life and here you can discover the most intimate and personal side of the artist. A place of unique beauty, in the middle of an extraordinary palm grove, located in the beautiful village of Haría. At the beginning of 1986, Manrique started the construction of his last house by reusing and adapting a farmhouse, in ruins, located on a farm he had acquired in the seventies. He lived here until 1992, the year of his death. The visitor will be able to enjoy a unique experience in a peaceful natural environment. A truly unique world that allows you to get closer to the more human side of the great artist born in Lanzarote. The unique conditions of the building make it partially accessible for people with reduced mobility.

With authorised transport (our minibuses and tours), you avoid long waits during the high season.

**Clothing**
Bring a jacket. Even if it is sunny on the coast, the park is often windy.

The ride is optional and paid for on site.

Islote de Hilario and El Golfo are hard to beat: do not forget your camera.

la-geria-vino-volcanico.content:
